observations: A black PlayStation 4 Slim console is shown.
Two black DualShock 4 controllers are present.
One physical game disc case for FIFA 22 is visible.
Power, HDMI, and USB cables are included.
The image contains a watermark 'CHIBROS MUSICALS POSTED ON JIJI' across the bottom.

claims.evidence: No video or screen capture shows the console in operation.
The physical game case in photo 0 is FIFA 22.
FIFA 26 does not exist; the series rebranded to EA Sports FC after FIFA 23.

risks.risk: The listing is likely a scam using a stolen photo.
risks.proof: A photo of the console next to a handwritten note with the current date and buyer's name.

risks.risk: The console may be hardware-banned from online services or have a failing disc drive.
risks.proof: Video showing the console connecting to the PlayStation Store and loading a physical disc.

risks.risk: The storage capacity is unknown (500GB vs 1TB).
risks.proof: Photo of the 'Settings > Storage' menu screen.

proof_requests: Photo of the console with a handwritten note showing today's date and your name.
Video of the console booting up and launching a game.
Photo of the system storage information screen.
Photos of the other games mentioned (Ghost of Tsushima, Spider-Man).
response.reason: The seller claims to include 'fifa 26', a game that does not exist, and the photo is watermarked by a third-party business ('CHIBROS MUSICALS'), which strongly suggests the image was stolen from another listing.
